question: ________ is the first Indian dancer, a transgender, to be honoured with Padma Shri.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narthaki Nataraj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Narthaki Nataraj is the **first Indian dancer** from the transgender community to be honored with the Padma Shri.
 
• She is renowned for her expertise in **Bharatanatyam, specifically the Tanjore style.**
 
• Narthaki has broken significant barriers, becoming a trailblazer for the transgender community in the field of classical dance.
 
• She has performed globally and has been recognized for her contributions to Indian classical dance and culture.
 
• Her Padma Shri award highlights her efforts in bringing both artistic excellence and social change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fc45a235458ddf07afe353f1a770c71899fa2dc8f7b0d2bfa107cd96d3c3fbb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Protima Bedi:**

 
 
• Protima Bedi was a renowned **Indian Odissi dancer.**
 
• She is famous for **founding the Nrityagram dance** village near Bengaluru.
 
 
 
• **Alarmel Valli:**
 
 
• Alarmel Valli is a celebrated** Bharatanatyam dancer.**
 
• She is known for her graceful and lyrical dance style.
 
 
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy:**
 
 
• Yamini Krishnamurthy is a highly respected dancer of** Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.**
 
• She has received numerous accolades for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
